title: 12 Best Things to Do Solo in Bangkok
description: Discover the 12 best solo adventures in Bangkok, from immersive cooking classes and serene temples to vibrant street markets and relaxing spa experiences. Explore Bangkok safely and independently in 2026.

places.name: Baipai Thai Cooking School
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The full-day cooking class, which typically covers 4-5 dishes like Tom Yum Goong, Green Curry, Pad Thai, and Mango Sticky Rice.

places.name: Wat Pho (Temple of the Reclining Buddha)
places.priceRange: THB 200 per person (~$5.50 USD) for entry
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take your time observing the 46-meter long Reclining Buddha, then explore the surrounding chedis and learn about traditional Thai massage at the on-site school.

places.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Indulge in some Coconut Ice Cream, try a variety of grilled skewers, and hunt for unique souvenirs or fashion items.

places.name: Chao Phraya Express Boat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A one-way ticket on the orange flag boat (most frequent and goes to key tourist spots) for a scenic ride between Saphan Taksin BTS station and Phra Arthit pier.

places.name: Lumpini Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Find a bench by the lake, enjoy a leisurely stroll, or join in a free public aerobics class in the evenings.

places.name: Health Land Spa & Massage Asoke
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The traditional Thai massage for 2 hours. It's a full-body, therapeutic experience that will leave you feeling completely refreshed.

places.name: Museum Siam
places.priceRange: THB 100 per person for foreigners (~$2.80 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take your time with the 'Decoding Thainess' exhibition, which covers various aspects of Thai culture, history, and people through multimedia displays.

places.name: Yaowarat (Chinatown) Street Food
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the famous Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup), Hoy Tod (oyster or mussel omelet), Guay Jab (rolled rice noodle soup), and some delicious durian or mango sticky rice for dessert.

places.name: The Commons Thonglor
places.priceRange: THB 150-500+ per person (~$4-14+ USD) for food/drinks
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Grab a coffee from Roots, a pastry from Maison Jean Philippe, or a healthy meal from Roast. There are plenty of options for different tastes.

places.name: Rajadamnern Boxing Stadium
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Purchase a standard seat ticket if you want a good view of the action and to be amongst the local bettors, or a ringside seat for an up-close perspective.

places.name: Bangkok Art & Culture Centre (BACC)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Wander through the current exhibitions, visit the independent craft shops on the lower floors, and enjoy a coffee at one of the cozy cafes.

places.name: Wat Saket (The Golden Mount)
places.priceRange: THB 50 per person for foreigners (~$1.40 USD)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Take your time climbing the winding path, enjoying the serene garden, bells, and gongs along the way. At the top, soak in the unobstructed views, especially at sunset.
